body: From the DM-183 review (orchestrator, this run): docs/runbooks/mcp-setup.md, docs/space-grading.md and the assertPersonEstimates comment overstate the rule — an agent may not KEEP or INTRODUCE the person_estimate label, but may replace a person's budget with a planner_estimate budget or clear it (visible in the plan diff). Fix the wording to say exactly that. Document the 1-minute floor for rescue/planned-review minutes.
